checklist.title: Falsify State Rollback Completeness on Transaction Failure
checklist.bug_class: Incomplete State Revert / Residual Side Effects
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute a transaction that modifies multiple state elements (storage, balance, nonce, code) and then fails (e.g., REVERT or OOG). 2. Compare state after rollback against the pre-transaction snapshot. All modified elements must be restored exactly. 3. Test with nested CALL frames where inner calls succeed but the outer call fails. Verify all inner call effects are reverted. 4. Test with LOG operations before failure. Verify logs are discarded on revert. 5. Test with SELFDESTRUCT followed by failure. Verify the account is not destroyed.
executable_checks: Locate state snapshot/journal mechanism
Check that all state modifications are tracked (storage, balance, nonce, code, logs, selfdestructs)
Test nested CALL with partial success then outer REVERT
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-AMSTERDAM-INV-002. Nodes: ACTION-ROLLBACK-STATE, ACTION-TRACK-STATE-CHANGES. Related: AMB-AMSTERDAM-01, ASSUM-AMSTERDAM-02.

checklist.title: Falsify Memory Expansion Gas Charged Before Memory Write
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute MSTORE to a high memory offset that requires significant expansion gas. Provide exactly enough gas for the expansion. Verify the write succeeds. 2. Provide 1 gas less than needed. Verify OOG occurs and memory is NOT modified. 3. Execute CALLDATACOPY to a new memory region with insufficient gas. Verify memory remains unchanged after OOG. 4. Verify that memory size is not updated before gas is deducted.
executable_checks: Locate memory expansion gas calculation in EVM
Check ordering: gas deduction before memory resize
Test MSTORE at offset requiring large expansion with borderline gas

checklist.title: Falsify Chain Switching Session Isolation (No Persistent Default Change)
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Note the wallet's default chain. Use wallet_switchEthereumChain to switch to a different chain. 2. Close and reopen the DApp session. Verify the wallet reverts to its default chain, not the session-switched chain. 3. Switch chains in one DApp tab. Verify another tab's chain is unaffected (if per-tab isolation is expected). 4. Verify the wallet's settings UI still shows the original default chain.
executable_checks: Locate wallet_switchEthereumChain handler
Check if chain switch persists to wallet configuration or is session-only
Test with multiple concurrent DApp sessions
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-B4-INV-009. Nodes: STATE-WALLET-ON-CHAIN-B. Related: AMB-EIP2015-03.

checklist.title: Falsify Uncle Block baseFee Matches Consensus-Validated Header Value
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Query an uncle block via eth_getUncleByBlockHashAndIndex. Extract the baseFee field. 2. Independently verify the baseFee by decoding the uncle block's RLP-encoded header. 3. Compare the two values. They must match exactly. 4. Test with uncle blocks at the EIP-1559 activation boundary to ensure baseFee is present/absent correctly.
executable_checks: Locate uncle block response serialization
Check baseFee field extraction from uncle header
Test with uncle from pre-EIP-1559 block
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-B4-INV-012. Nodes: STATE-BASEFEE-REQUIRED. Related: ASSUM-EIP3045-02.

checklist.title: Falsify KZG Trusted Setup Parameter Immutability and Correctness
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Read the KZG_SETUP_G2_MONOMIAL_1 value from the codebase. Compare it against the official ceremony output. 2. Verify the parameter is loaded from a read-only source and cannot be modified at runtime. 3. Verify the pairing check uses this exact parameter. 4. Attempt to substitute a different G2 point and verify the KZG proof verification fails.
executable_checks: Locate KZG_SETUP_G2_MONOMIAL_1 constant in code
Compare against official trusted setup ceremony output
Verify immutability (const/readonly/embedded)
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-B4-INV-015. Nodes: STATE-CRYPTO-TYPES-READY. Related: ASSUM-KZG-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Buffer Out-of-Bounds Read Returns Zero-Padded Data
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Read from a buffer at an offset beyond its length. Verify the result is zero-padded to the requested size. 2. Read with offset partially within and partially beyond the buffer. Verify the in-bounds portion contains correct data and the out-of-bounds portion is zero-filled. 3. Read with offset = buffer.length (exactly at boundary). Verify all-zero result. 4. Verify no uninitialized memory content is leaked in the padded region.
executable_checks: Locate buffer read/getData function with padding
Check zero-fill implementation for out-of-bounds reads
Test partial overlap: offset=len-1, size=32
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-001. Nodes: STATE-BUFFER-DATA-RETRIEVED. Related: AMB-PRAGUE-MEMORY-03.

checklist.title: Falsify Explorer Returns HTTP 404 for Non-Existent Resources
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Request a non-existent block hash via the block explorer. Verify HTTP 404 response. 2. Request a non-existent transaction hash. Verify 404. 3. Request a non-existent address page. Verify 404 (or appropriate response if all addresses are valid). 4. Verify the 404 page does not leak internal server information.
executable_checks: Test block explorer with known-invalid block hash
Test with invalid tx hash format vs valid-format-but-nonexistent
Check response status codes
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-004. Nodes: STATE-PAGE-RENDERED. Related: AMB-EIP3091-02.

checklist.title: Falsify PUSHn Stack Height and PC Advancement
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute PUSH1 0xFF. Verify stack height increases by 1 and PC advances by 2 (1 opcode + 1 byte). 2. Execute PUSH32 with 32 bytes. Verify stack height increases by 1 and PC advances by 33. 3. Execute PUSH1 at the very end of bytecode where the data byte is missing (truncated). Verify behavior per spec (zero-padded or error). 4. Execute PUSH0. Verify stack height increases by 1 and PC advances by 1.
executable_checks: Locate PUSHn opcode implementation
Verify PC increment = 1 + n
Test PUSH32 at end of bytecode with < 32 remaining bytes

checklist.title: Falsify SWAP Operation Correctness (Value Exchange)
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Push values [A, B, C, D] onto the stack. Execute SWAP3 (swaps position 0 and 3). Verify stack = [D, B, C, A]. 2. Execute SWAP1. Verify stack[0] and stack[1] are exchanged. 3. Execute SWAPn with minimum stack depth exactly equal to n+1. Verify success. 4. Execute SWAPn with stack depth < n+1. Verify stack underflow error. 5. Verify all non-swapped positions remain unchanged.
executable_checks: Locate SWAPn opcode implementation
Verify in-place swap without temporary corruption
Test all SWAP variants (SWAP1-SWAP16) at minimum stack depth

checklist.title: Falsify POP Operation Decreases Stack Height by Exactly 1
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Push values [A, B, C]. Execute POP. Verify stack = [A, B] with B at position 0. 2. Execute POP on a stack with exactly 1 element. Verify stack becomes empty. 3. Execute POP on an empty stack. Verify stack underflow error. 4. Verify the popped value is not accessible by any subsequent operation.
executable_checks: Locate POP opcode implementation
Verify stack pointer decrement by 1
Test POP on empty stack

checklist.title: Falsify EIP-1559 Effective Gas Price Computation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Set max_fee=100, max_priority_fee=10, base_fee=80. Expected effective = min(10, 100-80) + 80 = 90. Verify. 2. Set max_fee=100, max_priority_fee=30, base_fee=80. Expected = min(30, 20) + 80 = 100. Verify. 3. Set max_fee=base_fee (no priority fee possible). Expected = base_fee. Verify. 4. Set max_priority_fee=0. Expected = base_fee. Verify. 5. Verify that max_fee < base_fee is rejected before this calculation.
executable_checks: Locate effective gas price calculation
Verify min() operation correctness
Test edge: max_fee == base_fee, max_priority_fee > 0

checklist.title: Falsify Access List Warm-Marking for Addresses and Storage Keys
checklist.bug_class: Cold/Warm State Error / Incorrect Gas Charging
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a type-1 transaction with an access list declaring address A and storage key K. 2. Execute SLOAD on A:K during the transaction. Verify warm-cost (100 gas) is charged, not cold-cost (2100). 3. Execute BALANCE on address A. Verify warm-cost (100) not cold-cost (2600). 4. Access an address NOT in the access list. Verify cold-cost is charged. 5. Verify the warm state does not persist beyond the transaction.
executable_checks: Locate access list pre-warming in transaction processing
Verify warm markers are set before EVM execution begins
Test SLOAD cost for access-listed vs non-listed storage key
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-018. Nodes: STATE-ACCESS-LIST-APPLIED. Related: ASSUM-LONDON-04.
